# ConvoSync

> Shared WhatsApp Business inbox for teams — reply as a group from one number, automate conversations with AI agents, run WhatsApp broadcast campaigns, and accept payments with WhatsApp Pay. Also covers Instagram DMs and email.

ConvoSync is a B2B SaaS product built by Lazybinary. It answers the questions teams usually search for one at a time — "whatsapp business multiple agents same number," "whatsapp shared inbox for team," "ai chatbot for whatsapp business," "whatsapp bulk broadcast tool," "connect whatsapp to crm" — as a single platform: a shared team inbox, WhatsApp Business API access, AI agents, campaign broadcasts, and a lightweight CRM together.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://www.convosync.io/): Product overview, pricing, and marketing site.
- [Start a free trial](https://app.convosync.io/signup): 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

## Capabilities

- **WhatsApp Inbox** — Shared team inbox for WhatsApp conversations: assign chats to teammates, apply labels, add internal notes, use quick replies, and see full conversation history.
- **Message Templates** — Meta-approved WhatsApp message templates (text, media, or interactive buttons) with variables, typically approved within 1–24 hours.
- **Campaigns** — Bulk WhatsApp broadcasts to CSV-uploaded contact lists, scheduled or sent immediately, with delivered/read/replied analytics and A/B testing on paid plans.
- **Journey Builder** — Visual drag-and-drop automation builder with triggers (inbound message, contact tag, campaign reply), actions (send message, assign agent, add tag, wait), and if/else branching — used for lead nurturing, onboarding, and re-engagement.
- **AI Agent** — Configurable 24/7 chatbot (autonomous, responsive, or rule-based) with a knowledge base built from documents, Q&A pairs, or web URLs, plus escalation and handoff rules, in any language.
- **Contacts & CRM** — Contact directory with CSV import, custom attributes, tags for segmentation, and a per-contact activity timeline.
- **Reports & Analytics** — Message delivery rates, campaign performance, agent response time, conversation volume trends, and AI agent resolution rate.
- **WhatsApp Pay** — Payment requests, settlements, and invoice status tracked directly inside the chat.
- **Instagram Automation** — Automated DM and comment replies with triggers and quick replies.
- **Meta & Google Ads** — Click-to-WhatsApp campaign management and ad performance tracking.
